newsitem.title: UK: UK regulator to release metals report on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: UK regulator to release metals report on Thursday.

text.p: Britian's top financial markets watchdog the Securities and Investments Board (SIB) said it will release its report on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Thursday.
The report by the SIB was commissioned by the LME after the Sumitomo Corp scandal rocked financial markets in June this year.
UK regulator to release metals report on Thursday
"The report will come out on Thursday," a spokeswoman told Reuters.

Industry sources have said that the SIB may suggest changes, such as daily reporting of inventory movements, revealing ownership of those inventories in warehouses and more transparency in market positions.
Changes in LME membership may also be advised.
Sumitomo fired its head copper trader Yasuo Hamanaka in June, accusing him of running up losses of $2.6 billion in unauthorised trading.
